title: reflect-kb learning frontmatter (v4)
description: YAML frontmatter for a reflect-kb learning document (documents/*.md). The v4 spec pins the ten fields enumerated here; additional fields are tolerated so real-world provenance/ingest metadata survives validation. OKF v0.2 profile: every note reflect writes is also an Open Knowledge Format v0.2 concept, so the OKF keys (type, description, resource, sources, generated, verified, status, stale_after) are described here too. They are optional in this schema so pre-profile notes keep validating; reflect's writers always emit `type`, `title`, `description` and `generated`.

category.description: Free-form classifier (e.g. build-errors, architecture, memories, feedback). CODEOWNERS routing keys off this value.

tags.description: Retrieval tags (lowercase kebab or short words). No semantic meaning beyond boosting recall.

symptoms.description: Error messages, stack traces, or observable signals that match this learning. Used for symptom-based retrieval.

root_cause.description: One-sentence diagnosis of *why* the problem happens.

key_insight.description: One-sentence actionable takeaway — what the next engineer should do differently.

created.description: ISO-8601 date the learning was first captured (YYYY-MM-DD).

confidence.description: Confidence tier. HIGH auto-commits to team KB; MED/LOW goes through PR review.

language.description: Primary programming language (e.g. python, rust, typescript). Lowercase preferred.

framework.description: Primary framework / runtime (e.g. tokio, react, django). Lowercase preferred.

type.description: OKF (SPEC 4.1): the one key every OKF concept must carry. reflect writes `learning` (legacy `LEARNING` is normalized to lowercase on write).

description.description: OKF (SPEC 4.1): one-line summary, derived from `key_insight` (else the body's first sentence), at most ~200 characters.

resource.description: OKF (SPEC 4.1): canonical URI of the underlying asset, when the note describes one.

sources.description: OKF provenance (SPEC 5.1): materials the note derives from. reflect maps `source_path` (or `session_id` as `session:<id>`) here.

author.description: OKF actor (SPEC 7): `<producer>/<version>` for tools (e.g. `reflect-drain/5.2.5`), `human:<id>` for people, `process:<id>` for automated processes.

generated.description: OKF trust (SPEC 5.2): which writer produced the content and when (`at` mirrors `created`).

by.description: OKF actor (SPEC 7): `<producer>/<version>` for tools (e.g. `reflect-drain/5.2.5`), `human:<id>` for people, `process:<id>` for automated processes.

verified.description: OKF trust (SPEC 5.2): verification events. A bare mapping counts as a one-element list. Mutable after write (Rule S9 carve-out).

by.description: OKF actor (SPEC 7): `<producer>/<version>` for tools (e.g. `reflect-drain/5.2.5`), `human:<id>` for people, `process:<id>` for automated processes.

at.description: When the verification happened (ISO 8601 with explicit offset).

by.description: OKF actor (SPEC 7): `<producer>/<version>` for tools (e.g. `reflect-drain/5.2.5`), `human:<id>` for people, `process:<id>` for automated processes.

at.description: When the verification happened (ISO 8601 with explicit offset).

status.description: OKF lifecycle (SPEC 5.4): draft | stable | deprecated; absent means stable. `reflect serve` archive sets `deprecated`. Observation notes (`type: observation`) keep reflect's own `active | retired` (see allOf). Mutable after write (Rule S9 carve-out).

stale_after.description: OKF lifecycle (SPEC 5.5): absolute instant after which the note is stale. Mirrors `forget_after` (which is kept for back-compat). Mutable after write (Rule S9 carve-out).
